children.description:
Defines the items of the `NotificationListGroupItem`,
usually `NotificationListItem` items.

__Supported Node Type/s:__ `Array<NotificationListItem>`
children.x-typescriptType: string | number | boolean | ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Array<ReactNode>

className.description:
CSS Class Name which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, overwriting CSS rules might break the component.

collapsed.description: Defines if the group is collapsed or expanded.

growing.description:
Defines whether the component will have growing capability by pressing a `More` button.
When button is pressed `load-more` event will be fired.

**Note:** Available since [v2.2.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.2.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents-fiori**.

loading.description: Defines if a busy indicator would be displayed over the item.

loadingDelay.description: Defines the delay in milliseconds, after which the busy indicator will show up for this component.

onLoadMore.description:
Fired when additional items are requested.

**Note:** Available since [v2.2.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.2.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents-fiori**.

| cancelable | bubbles |
| :--------: | :-----: |
| ❌|✅|

onToggle.description:
Fired when the `NotificationListGroupItem` is expanded/collapsed by user interaction.

| cancelable | bubbles |
| :--------: | :-----: |
| ❌|✅|

read.description:
Defines if the `notification` is new or has been already read.

**Note:** if set to `false` the `titleText` has bold font,
if set to true - it has a normal font.

style.description:
Element style which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, some css properties might break the component.

waitForDefine.description:
Defines whether the component should wait for the underlying custom element of the web component to be defined. This can be useful, for example, for using instance methods when mounting the component.

__Note:__ This adds a rendering cycle to your component.
